axes.concept: A decorator’s measured installation sheet: a live top-view drawing, actual furniture quantities and the GLB handoff.
axes.layout: Asymmetric two-line title and right project caption; broad drawing with a narrow inspector; eight type cards below; seven ruled Backing rows; a count rail beside the shopping list; a file sheet beside import instructions.
axes.navigation: Four direct ruled chapter buttons across the working width; 2×2 chapter matrix on phones; no drawer, folder index, carousel or gesture dependency.
axes.typography: Locally embedded Syne Variable display at 50–80 px, Instrument Sans Variable working copy at 13–16 px, JetBrains Mono Variable measures at 11–13 px; tabular quantities.
axes.density: Compact measured information with open gutters, square edged working fields, ruled rows, 44 px controls; drawing takes precedence over decorative cards.
axes.components: Real shadcn/Base UI Button and Input, real Alert and Skeleton; custom CSS drawing, dimension rules, table type silhouettes and Backing cross-sections; no fallback HTML kit.
axes.colour: Proposed cool installation paper #e9ecee/#f9fafb and registration red #a81e2d; dark graphite #161c20/#20292f with pale red #ff9ba6. Existing Pictures semantic token names are mapped to kit roles.
axes.motion: Precise registration cuts, cubic-bezier(.76,0,.24,1), 350–820 ms staged entrances; seats offset 45 ms and type cards 32 ms; 200 ms press/hover; scroll catalogue register, state strike and GLB index; reduced motion and still mode settle immediately.
